name: kton-workbench
description: One VS Code window onto a kton federation through the cockpit CLI: Home, Inbox and threads, decisions, lanes, and the one sign dialog for person-key signatures.

scripts.package: npm run bundle && vsce package --no-dependencies -o out/kton-workbench.vsix

commands.title: kton workbench: open a surface session in a new window
kton workbench: open recorded runs in the recorder
kton workbench: choose an option of a decision
kton workbench: open a package view for a subject
kton workbench: open a package's review view for a waiting decision

kton.cockpit.path.description: The cockpit executable. A setting, never derived from data.

kton.cockpit.timeoutSeconds.description: How long one cockpit call may take. A call that takes longer is reported as failed; whether it signed is then for the registry to say.

kton.home.openOnStart.description: When the window starts and exactly one decision is waiting that a package's review view applies to, open that review view.

kton.poll.seconds.description: How often the inbox is polled (by code, never by a language model).

kton.queries.dir.description: Folder with the SPARQL texts of the display-only views (proposals, messages, lanes .rq). decides and answers are asked by name from an admitted package, never from this folder; templates come from the cockpit's listing.

kton.identity.personKey.description: Key name of the person key (decisions, always through the sign dialog). Its key id is derived from <keyring>/<name>-claims.pub.

kton.identity.agentKey.description: Key name of the agent/home key (records, no dialog).

kton.identity.personTiers.description: Trust tiers whose signers are persons. A decision counts only when this window's person key or a signer of one of these tiers signed it; any other signer's claim is shown as a record.

kton.surfaces.file.description: Surfaces file in the workgroup format ({surface: {lanes: {name: {lane}}, folder?}}).

kton.surfaces.folderPattern.description: Folder of a surface session when the surface has no "folder", with ${surface}.

kton.surfaces.current.description: The surface the views show at start ("all" for every area).

kton.cockpit.transport.description: How the workbench talks to the cockpit: the command line (one process per call, the default), or one cockpit serve --stdio per window (the frontend protocol, SPEC §12.5: cockpit v0.5.6 or later).

kton.sources.dir.description: Folder with the local git mirrors (one per repository) from which evidence opens files as they were at a commit, read-only (git show). Empty: sources are not available on this host.

kton.artifacts.dir.description: Read-only root of run artifacts: <run>/<name>, shown only when the bytes hash to the run-artifact claim's sha256. Empty: run artifacts are not available on this host.

kton.inbox.areas.description: When not empty: the window shows only messages and proposals of these areas (Inbox, Home, decisions waiting), e.g. one role's own area.

kton.inbox.relayKeys.description: Key ids (16 hex) of relays: keys that re-sign other senders' messages with the text prefix "[from <sender> · <time>]". Only a message signed by one of these keys is shown with that sender and time (the relay stays named); the same prefix from any other key is shown as plain text under its real signer. The message queries must select the signer IRI as ?s.

kton.sources.aliases.description: Where data names a repository otherwise than its mirror folder under kton.sources.dir: data name → folder name.

kton.identity.testKeys.description: The window's keys are test keys: the status bar shows TEST MODE and names the keys as test keys. Off: neither is shown, and an unverified key is shown as unverified.
